integrity: The explicit all-size proof uses a published radicality theorem; finite-field checks are corroborative, not all-size certification. No experimental count is substituted for the geometric argument.
scientific_limitations: The original dense/sparse determinantal radicality theorem is prior literature; the new content is the explicit star decomposition and transverse nodal geometry. The nonreduced Jacobian ideal and characteristic-two local analytic types are not determined. Independent validation has not occurred.
title: Prime decomposition and nodal strata of star-structured symmetric determinantal hypersurfaces
